title: Doktor KosMed public-site performance baseline
scope: Production public HTML route response and Cache-Control headers
Representative Uzbek and Russian public pages measured on simulated mobile and desktop profiles
Lighthouse performance score, FCP, LCP, CLS, TBT, transferred bytes, and server-response-time opportunities

reproduction.source: Profile values reconstructed from the per-run Lighthouse JSON configSettings. The original shell commands and output paths were not retained as durable files.

raw_report_links.reason: No durable Lighthouse report URLs were created for this run. The per-run aggregate values used for this baseline are retained below; raw local reports are not published.
raw_report_links.reproduction: Use method.reproduction with measured_origin and each measurements[].path; raw report links are unavailable because this run did not publish durable report artifacts.

cloudflare_rum_blocking.reason: A Cloudflare Web Analytics/RUM beacon was observed in the initial probe; later measurements blocked the script and beacon to avoid additional telemetry submissions.
cloudflare_rum_blocking.control_verification: All 14 blocked measurement reports showed zero transferred bytes for the beacon script and no /cdn-cgi/rum request.

field_data.reason: The PageSpeed Insights API returned HTTP 429 Too Many Requests; no field p75 metrics were retrieved.
field_data.note: Lighthouse TBT is a lab metric and is not an INP measurement. Lab samples do not establish Core Web Vitals p75 compliance.

findings.observation: Lighthouse estimated 411-1104 ms savings from reducing initial server response time across the sampled routes. This is a diagnostic opportunity, not a verified root cause or guaranteed saving.
findings.verification_needed: Inspect aggregate Vercel Function and FastAPI request timings before attributing the delay to SSR, backend, database, or network.

findings.observation: The production page loaded static.cloudflareinsights.com/beacon.min.js (10478 transferred bytes) and made a request to /cdn-cgi/rum (HTTP 204). Cloudflare documents these as its Web Analytics/RUM beacon and reporting endpoint. The Cloudflare dashboard lists finalclinic.fyi in Web Analytics with automatic setup and shows RUM enabled while excluding EU visitors; the selected setting states that the JS snippet is not injected for EU visitors. The public-site plan excludes external RUM for the first release. No app-level reference was found in the searched frontend, Vercel, ops, and workflow paths. The dashboard listed 10 page views and 10 visits in the last 24 hours; these counts are not field p75 Core Web Vitals data.
findings.verification_needed: Resolve the policy conflict with the owner before treating the first-release no-external-RUM requirement as satisfied. No Cloudflare setting was changed.

unblocked_detection_probe.note: One anonymous synthetic browser visit triggered a beacon. No patient account, patient record, or user-entered data was used. This probe is excluded from the blocked-RUM measurement summary.

core_web_vitals_targets.source: Project plan section 12.2; Google web.dev Core Web Vitals thresholds

limitations: One Lighthouse run per route and device profile; results are a directional lab snapshot and can vary between runs.

Routes sampled: Uzbek and Russian home, both localized service catalogs, Uzbek doctor/prices/contacts listings. Russian doctors/prices/contacts and individual service/doctor details were not measured.
No CrUX or other field p75 data was available.
INP was not measured; TBT must not be treated as its substitute.
Cloudflare RUM was blocked during the 14-run summary, so those transfer-size values exclude that script and endpoint.
The Lighthouse waterfall cannot separate Vercel Function, FastAPI, database, and network time; no backend or database root cause is assigned.

deployment.change_note: PR #3734 was docs-only; the public-site runtime code was not changed.

http_probe.method: Three sequential GET requests per target; curl time_starttransfer, rounded to milliseconds.
http_probe.timing_limit: Client-side time_starttransfer includes DNS, TCP, TLS, network transit, and response time; it is not an isolated server TTFB.

samples.note: Same-host measurement bypasses Cloudflare and the Vercel-to-API path; it is not directly comparable to the public API route.

http_probe.cache_observation: PowerShell probes observed cfCacheStatus DYNAMIC for the homepage and public API.

vercel_timing_evidence.conclusion: No aggregate Vercel Function duration or request-level FastAPI timing was available; no delay is attributed to Nitro, FastAPI, the database, or the network.

rum_follow_up.note: The read-only dashboard review confirmed Web Analytics/RUM is enabled with EU visitors excluded. This probe checked delivered HTML but did not execute browser JavaScript. The earlier unblocked synthetic browser probe in this audit observed the beacon request. Dashboard page-view and visit counts do not establish LCP, INP, or CLS p75. No Cloudflare setting was changed.

limitations: Three sequential samples from one Windows host on one date are a point-in-time diagnostic, not a field p75 or performance baseline.
Direct public API timings cannot be used to infer the Vercel Function's server-to-server API duration.
Local loopback FastAPI timings do not establish the cause of the public-route delay.

Cloudflare Web Analytics/RUM is configured to run outside the EU, which conflicts with the approved no-external-RUM first-release policy; no setting change or policy exception is authorized by this audit.

next_actions.action: The Cloudflare dashboard confirms Web Analytics/RUM is enabled with EU visitors excluded. Decide whether to disable it to meet the approved no-external-RUM first-release policy. No setting change has been made.
Obtain separate duration-capable Vercel Function and FastAPI timings before assigning a cause; use minimized telemetry without PHI/PII or raw query strings.
Recheck CrUX/PageSpeed Insights when field data is available and record p75 LCP, INP, and CLS separately from the Lighthouse lab baseline.

result: Directional Lighthouse baseline captured on production merge SHA. Performance scores were 96-100 and lab LCP 253-2185 ms across representative routes, but this is not field p75 compliance. The 2026-10-22 follow-up captured point-in-time client timings and confirmed the RUM marker remains in homepage HTML; the Cloudflare dashboard confirms Web Analytics/RUM is enabled outside the EU, which conflicts with the approved first-release policy. Vercel Function/FastAPI duration attribution and field p75 remain unavailable.
